reviews.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Requesting changes at 0f968c49 for one red test. The rest of the change looks right to me.

[P1 blocking] CI fails on `src/__tests__/workflow-engine.test.ts`, in `asks a prompt step for its output as JSON Schema, or for a summary when it declares none`. All three Lint & Test jobs and the coverage job show it:

```
AssertionError: expected 'a value that matches this JSON Schema…' to be 'a value that matches this JSON Schema…'
Test Files  1 failed | 751 passed | 2 skipped (754)
```

The test still pins the old properties at line 336:

```
'"properties":{"definition":{"type":"object"},"workflows":{"type":"object"},"scorers":{"type":"object"},"teamRevision":{"type":"string"}},'
```

This PR now renders only `definition` and `workflows`, so the expectation needs the same change:

```diff
-        + '"properties":{"definition":{"type":"object"},"workflows":{"type":"object"},"scorers":{"type":"object"},"teamRevision":{"type":"string"}},'
+        + '"properties":{"definition":{"type":"object"},"workflows":{"type":"object"}},'
```

On the rest of the change:

- Moving `BundleSchema` into `output.ts` and deriving the advertised keys from `BundleSchema.shape` keeps the brief and admission in step. It also avoids an import cycle, since `admission.ts` already imports from `output.ts` and not the other way round.
- The two guide pages and the `OutputSchema` comment match the new bundle.
- Hidden scope: none. The only output that changes is the schema in the brief, and it now matches what admission already accepted. A bundle with `scorers` was refused before and is still refused.
- The real-CLI record in the body shows the new schema in a dispatched brief.
- The CI review found nothing in the diff. I agree, apart from this test, which it could not see without running the suite.

I'll approve and merge once this is fixed and CI is green.
Fixed in 62f7a7a: the engine test now expects only `definition` and `workflows`. CI is green. Approving.
